summary: Schedule a one-shot Node.js timeout while preserving handle identity, delay normalization, callback receiver, and event-loop liveness.

target.notes: Return a Node Timeout handle; schedule through the Node-compatible timers phase rather than a generic Task scheduler.

semantics.delay: default 1 ms; numeric delay <1, NaN, or >2147483647 becomes 1; non-integer delays are truncated for scheduling; timers use a threshold rather than an exact execution time
semantics.arguments: extra arguments are passed to callback
semantics.callback_this: ordinary function receives the Timeout handle as this
semantics.overflow_warning: out-of-range delays may emit Node TimeoutOverflowWarning under the selected host profile

caveats: System.Threading.Timer/Task.Delay alone do not preserve Node event-loop phase ordering or ref/unref liveness.
Arrow-function this remains lexical under FUNCTIONS semantics.
Preserve host-visible warning behavior when compatibility requires Node TimeoutOverflowWarning.

tests.name: callback is asynchronous and receives args
